decision_cruda.rationale: LH-05 is down at C590-03 (radio and CMMS agree). Likely repair is 11:30, range 11:00 to 12:00. The stope holds 253 t at 10 g/t, about 81 oz. LH-05 alone could load only about 182 t by 17:00 after the repair. LH-08 comes from the cheap infrastructure heading (0.5 oz/h) and takes 0.58 h to arrive. It covers the outage and adds loading capacity afterwards. Central has about 20 t/h of truck headroom (91 capacity against 71 inflow) and 131 t of stockpile buffer. Estimated gain is roughly 10 to 20 oz against about 3 oz of development cost. I did not move LH-09 because its heading is worth 2 oz/h. LH-10 is in preventive maintenance until 14:00.
